_doc: Single source of truth for the accounts. name = suffix of the aliases (claude-<name>, claude-<name>-login, claude-usage-<name>). config_dir = that account's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; '~/.claude' is Claude Code's default directory (used without the variable). default_account = the account that plain `claude` opens. tmux = open each account in a new tmux session (claude-<folder> for the default one, claude-<name>-<folder> for the others); attach by hand with tmux attach -t <name>. codex = install codex and create the codex-login and codex-usage aliases (Codex is not part of usage-all). orq_hosts = remote machines (ssh) that orq queries and where it opens agents; the laptop is always included. permission_mode = permission mode of the page's agents (orq web / orq-agent): auto (Claude decides routine things and asks about sensitive ones), manual (asks about everything), acceptEdits, plan.
